quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 product and technology results (annual report): a 780nm broad-stripe DFB laser exceeded 10W room-temperature CW output (company: a record for the 780nm band); 9XXnm fiber-laser pump source power raised to 1000W and 8XXnm solid-state laser pump to 500W; a single-mode VCSEL reached 20.2mW with 42% power conversion efficiency (company: a world record); its automotive lidar chips have passed IATF16949 and AEC-Q certification, and it is developing automotive EEL edge-emitting lasers and 1550nm fiber-laser pump sources. Its VCSEL chips serve consumer electronics / 3D sensing, short-reach optical communication in data centers, and lidar.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate (annual report): Everbright set up Suzhou Xingyao Photonics Technology through a wholly owned subsidiary to pursue silicon photonics integration (RMB 45,000,000.00 invested in 2025); the Xingyao project is still under construction and is expected to start trial line operation at the end of 2026. It covers thin-film lithium niobate materials through an investment in Suzhou Yunjing Optoelectronic Technology (lithium niobate / lithium tantalate crystals).

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (annual report): IPO-funded high-power laser chip, device and module capacity expansion project (RMB 59,933.25 ten-thousand planned, 84.96% invested) and the VCSEL and optical communication laser chip industrialization project (RMB 30,504.81 ten-thousand planned, 76.96% invested) both reached usable status in December 2024; construction in progress fell 73.90% to RMB 52,748,075.78, mainly on transfer to fixed assets. The self-funded advanced compound semiconductor optoelectronic platform new-build project (budget RMB 30,000.00 ten-thousand) is 53.28% invested.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view (annual report): the explosion of AI and compute demand has caused a global optical chip capacity shortage, which gives its business an opportunity window to go overseas; its optical communication products have gained initial market recognition, customer orders are gradually ramping and it is continuing to build capacity to meet growing customer demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 operating plan (annual report, company guidance, no figures): achieve scaled sales of automotive lidar products with key customers; fully start sales of communication products; further expand overseas while continuing domestic substitution; complete product-line technology platforms; in production, treat 'yield and capacity' as core competitiveness - stable operation of the new plant, full automation and lower unit manufacturing cost.
